title: Statistical Approach for Mg2+ and Mn2+ Mitigation in Water Sustainability
author: Mustamina, Maulani
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Collect water samples
steps.instruction: Collect surface water samples following the SNI 6989.57:2008 method for surface water sampling.

steps.title: Condition and activate adsorbents
steps.instruction: Condition and activate bentonite (and activated charcoal) as described in the initial preparation steps of the study.

steps.title: Perform adsorption experiments
steps.instruction: In a separating funnel, add the prepared adsorbent to the water sample and allow contact for 10, 20, or 30 minutes while maintaining the required temperature conditions.

substeps.instruction: Add measured amount of bentonite or activated charcoal to the sample.
Set the desired temperature (varying temperature conditions as tested).
Allow the mixture to stand for the chosen contact time (10 min, 20 min, or 30 min).

steps.title: Filter adsorption mixture
steps.instruction: After the specified contact time, filter the mixture to obtain the filtrate for subsequent analysis.

steps.title: Analyze Mn2+ by AAS
steps.instruction: Quantitatively determine Mn²⁺ concentration in the filtrate using atomic absorption spectroscopy.

steps.title: Analyze Mg2+ by titration
steps.instruction: Quantitatively determine Mg²⁺ concentration in the filtrate using complexometric titration.
